propositions: The reconciler lacks a runtime mechanism to select between backend implementations; currently the vendor is implicit in module imports.
A new `backend: str` field must be added to `ReconcilerConfig` in `src/rebar/_config_schema.py`, defaulting to 'jira', with `_as_choice` validation at config-load time to reject unknown keys.

A module-level registry with `register(key, factory)` decorator and `select_backend(config)` resolver must be created in `_backend_registry.py`, lazily importing `adapters` to populate registered backends before lookup.
JiraBackend must be registered via `@register('jira', ...)` decorator in `adapters/jira/backend.py` and `adapters/__init__.py` must import it to trigger registration as a side-effect.

No existing consumers (_load_acli, AcliClient construction sites, differ/apply modules) are rewired in this story; selection infrastructure is proven in isolation before coordinated rewiring in a later story.
The registry must support test isolation via `_reset_registry_for_test()` context manager and allow test backends to be registered and torn down without process-lifetime leaks.
